title: Concept: OAuth scope granted as wildcard
description: A scope value that grants every permission in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A wildcard scope means every downstream check is the only thing standing between a token holder and the whole API, and it is usually a misconfiguration rather than a decision.
applicability: Deployments that render a scope value that grants every permission into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A wildcard scope means every downstream check is the only thing standing between a token holder and the whole API, and it is usually a misconfiguration rather than a decision.
